settings.title: How to use
settings.content:
Tap 2–3 orbs onto your palm. Press to burst them into serum, then pat into clean skin morning and night. Follow with moisturiser.

If your skin reacts easily, patch test on your inner arm for 24 hours first.

settings.question: What is PDRN?
settings.answer: PDRN stands for polydeoxyribonucleotide, a fragment of DNA sourced from salmon. In skincare it is used as a hydrating, conditioning ingredient. Ours sits at 30,000ppm alongside hyaluronic acid.

settings.question: Is it vegan?
settings.answer: No. PDRN is salmon-derived, so the serum is not vegan. It is not tested on animals.

settings.question: Which skin types is it for?
